record.question: Which of the following bean is used to prepare wine
record.explanation: Source check: PDF p.4 (printed page 4, Q45) prints exactly 'Which of the following bean is used to prepare wine' with French Bean, Cluster Bean, Lima Bean, Dolichos Bean. The standard horticulture MCQ on this point gives broad/fava bean (Vicia faba) as the bean grown for wine processing (legume pods can be used, and broad bean has heavy, sweet pods), and broad bean is absent from this paper's option list. I could not verify any documented wine/fermented-beverage use for French bean, cluster bean (guar, Cyamopsis tetragonoloba), lima bean (Phaseolus lunatus) or dolichos bean (Lablab purpureus), and no Mizoram/North-East Indian bean-wine fact could be confirmed from horticultural sources. The item therefore looks defective (option list probably mis-set), so no option can be defended; a corrected option set or the keyed answer is needed before selecting one.
